profile.headline: Software Engineer @ LT Equipment Inc. | Distributed Systems | Web Applications | Embedded Systems | Game Development
profile.summary:
Our team at LASERTRON is shaping the future of interactive entertainment. With a foundation in distributed systems, networking, web development, and embedded operating systems, my contributions are pivotal in driving our websites, game development and previously enhancing flight systems.

Skilled in JavaScript and Python related technologies, my role involves both back-end and front-end web development / networking, as well as game development. We're leveraging these competencies to push boundaries in our projects for ourselves and clients, ensuring seamless integration and an exceptional user experience in multiple systems, such as our POS systems, support sites, and social game attractions.

positions.title: System Engineer & Software Engineer Assistant
positions.description:
Built and tested Guidance, Navigation, and Control software in C, Python, and NASA cFS for a student-led satellite program funded by the U.S. Army.

Integrated gyroscope data and developed magnetometer and GPS tooling supporting satellite orientation, navigation, and simulated flight testing.

Led weekly coordination for a 16-member engineering team and translated subsystem requirements into software tasks, technical reviews, and integration work.

Automated extraction of 40,000+ function parameters, reducing manual lookup work and supporting memory optimization on Intel Edison flight hardware.
